author: Marcus R. Brown
description:
- Introduced AccessibilityProvider and related hooks for managing accessibility state.
- Implemented screen reader announcements with ARIA live regions and focus management.
- Enhanced keyboard navigation with new shortcuts and accessibility-focused key parsing.
- Added ScreenReaderHelper and KeyboardShortcutsHelp components for better user guidance.
- Created utility functions for generating keyboard shortcuts help and announcing actions to screen readers.
- Updated CommandTerminal to utilize new accessibility features and keyboard shortcuts.
- Refactored utility functions to support extended terminal key handling.

Closes #942.
title: feat: add comprehensive accessibility features for terminal components
